cv.name: Nadia Saint-Amour
cv.headline: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner – Tech & Video Games
cv.summary: Bilingual recruiter with nine years of full-cycle recruiting for game studios, SaaS and AI start-ups in Montréal. Known for building calibrated interview loops with hiring managers and keeping candidate experience high in competitive markets.

experience.title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner
bullets: Own hiring for engineering and art teams, closing 45–60 roles per year
Reduced average time-to-fill for senior engineers from 62 to 41 days
Built structured interview kits and trained 30 hiring managers on bias-aware assessment
Manage relationships with two specialised agencies and the international mobility provider

experience.title: Technical Recruiter
bullets: Recruited developers, data scientists and DevOps engineers for a 300-person SaaS company
Launched an employee referral program that became the top source of hires

experience.title: Recruitment Consultant
bullets: Placed IT and finance contractors with clients across Greater Montréal

certifications: CRHA (Ordre des conseillers en ressources humaines agréés)
